Let me explore `/opt/abb-sdk-repo` — the `.kuma/case.json` mentions "replicated".

```python
import subprocess, json

r = subprocess.run("ls -la /opt/abb-sdk-repo 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && ls -la /opt/abb-sdk-repo/.kuma 2>/dev/null", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print("="*70)
print("case.json:")
try:
    print(open("/opt/abb-sdk-repo/.kuma/case.json").read()[:5000])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)
```
